answer: Agents register through a TPM/SGX enclave: zero-knowledge attestation binds each execution key to measured code and hardware identity; the bridge contract commits proofs into the saffron state tree, while the ledge verifier rejects nonce reuse. Forging N identities requires physically provisioning N distinct devices and passing enclave measurements, incurs quadratic bonding O(N^2), and causes irreversible collateral slashing for failed proofs.
